stories.title: M-57 crash closes all lanes Sunday evening
stories.summary: MSP are responding to the incident and Kent County Sheriff's Office is assisting, the sheriff's office confirmed. Injuries and damages are not yet known.

stories.title: Despite court ruling, DOE issues another order for J.H. Campbell Generating Plant to stay open
stories.summary: In September, a U.S. Court of Appeals ruled the DOE's order to keep J.H. Campbell Generator operating as unlawful. The DOE "disagrees" and has issued another order.

stories.title: SUV crash led to foot chase, injury and road closure in Park Township
stories.summary: Deputies arrived at the scene to find a power line fallen across the roadway, multiple signs damaged and a white Acura SUV stopped just passed a nearby parking lot.

stories.title: Man shot in foot Saturday night during fight
stories.summary: The man was driven to the hospital where it was determined his condition was not life threatening.

stories.title: Fox Sports' Big Noon Kick Off will come to Ferris State University for first Division II visit
stories.summary: The appointment was announced one day after Ferris State broke an NCAA Division II record for consecutive wins.

stories.title: Ferris State sets new NCAA Division II record after Saturday win over Roosevelt Lakers
stories.summary: The Ferris State Bulldogs now have 41 consecutive wins under their belt, beating the record of 40 previously set by Grand Valley State University.

stories.title: 2 dead, 1 injured in Mount Pleasant shooting
stories.summary: Police responded to a reported shooting in Mt. Pleasant and found two people deceased and one person seriously injured. There is no immediate threat to the public.

stories.title: Man and son dead after crash, 4-year-old daughter seriously injured
stories.summary: A Branch County crash claimed the lives of a 26-year-old man and his 5-year-old son. His 4-year-old daughter was seriously injured.

stories.title: FOUND: GRPD is asking for help locating a woman with medical concerns
stories.summary: She was last seen in the area of Ardmore Street and Eastern Avenue on Thursday at around 9:00 p.m., according to GRPD.

stories.title: Investigation underway after shots fired into Holland home with 4 inside
stories.summary: Police said there are currently no suspects in custody.

stories.title: 1 dead, 2 seriously injured in Barry County crash
stories.summary: A Dodge Nitro driven by a Nashville man is believed to have crossed the centerline and collided head-on with a Nissan Rogue.

stories.title: Michigan sues Mackinac Island ferry owner, alleging illegal monopoly
stories.summary: Michigan AG Dana Nessel says the Hoffman Family of Companies bought out its rivals and then raised fares and parking prices.
